source_text: Thank you so much for finding my phone.

structure.raw_value: ElFrOp#.Thank you so much for finding my phone.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrOp#.Thank you so much for finding my phone."

translation: Bardzo dziękuję za znalezienie mojego telefonu.

source_text: Glad I could help you out.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Glad I could help you out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Glad I could help you out."

translation: Cieszę się, że mogłem pomóc.

source_text: You didn’t go through my phone, did you?

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp.You didn’t go through my phone, did you?
structure.script_literal: "ElWoOp.You didn’t go through my phone, did you?"

translation: Nie przeglądałeś mojego telefonu, prawda?

source_text: Sorry. It’s just... I have to be very careful.

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx.Sorry. It’s just... I have to be very careful.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx.Sorry. It’s just... I have to be very careful."

translation: Przepraszam. Po prostu… muszę bardzo uważać.

source_text: So, you’re a model?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.So, you’re a model?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.So, you’re a model?"

translation: Czyli jesteś modelką?

source_text: You might say I'm out of touch, but I’ve never heard of you before.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You might say I'm out of touch, but I’ve never heard of you before.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You might say I'm out of touch, but I’ve never heard of you before."

translation: Może jestem nie na czasie, ale nigdy wcześniej o tobie nie słyszałem.

source_text: Really? But you’re so young. You don’t have a Lustagram account?

structure.raw_value: ElShOp.Really? But you’re so young. You don’t have a Lustagram account?
structure.script_literal: "ElShOp.Really? But you’re so young. You don’t have a Lustagram account?"

translation: Naprawdę? Jesteś taki młody. Nie masz konta na Lustagramie?

source_text: I didn’t even know what that was until today.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I didn’t even know what that was until today.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I didn’t even know what that was until today."

translation: Do dziś nawet nie wiedziałem, co to jest.

source_text: Haha. That’s so funny.

structure.raw_value: ElHaOpNo3.Haha. That’s so funny.
structure.script_literal: "ElHaOpNo3.Haha. That’s so funny."

translation: Haha. Ale zabawne.

source_text: I wouldn't expect a girl like you to make a home in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I wouldn't expect a girl like you to make a home in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I wouldn't expect a girl like you to make a home in North Santiva."

translation: Nie spodziewałbym się, że dziewczyna taka jak ty osiądzie w North Santiva.

source_text: What’s wrong with North Santiva?

structure.raw_value: ElFrOp.What’s wrong with North Santiva?
structure.script_literal: "ElFrOp.What’s wrong with North Santiva?"

translation: Co jest nie tak z North Santivą?

source_text: It’s got high speed internet and low taxes.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.It’s got high speed internet and low taxes.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.It’s got high speed internet and low taxes."

translation: Jest tu szybki internet i niskie podatki.

source_text: I guess that adds up. It’s just, you stick out like a sore thumb.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I guess that adds up. It’s just, you stick out like a sore thumb.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I guess that adds up. It’s just, you stick out like a sore thumb."

translation: To ma sens. Po prostu strasznie się tu wyróżniasz.

source_text: A sore thumb?

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.A sore thumb?
structure.script_literal: "ElWoCl.A sore thumb?"

translation: Wyróżniam?

source_text: The pink hair… You must get a lot of attention.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The pink hair… You must get a lot of attention.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The pink hair… You must get a lot of attention."

translation: Różowe włosy… Pewnie przyciągasz mnóstwo uwagi.

source_text: It’s my brand. My fans would kill me if I changed it.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.It’s my brand. My fans would kill me if I changed it.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.It’s my brand. My fans would kill me if I changed it."

translation: To mój znak rozpoznawczy. Fani by mnie zabili, gdybym je zmieniła.

source_text: It’s… pretty.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s… pretty.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s… pretty."

translation: Są… ładne.

source_text: You don’t have to humor me. I can read your mind.

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.You don’t have to humor me. I can read your mind.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.You don’t have to humor me. I can read your mind."

translation: Nie musisz być dla mnie miły. Wiem, co myślisz.

source_text: And what does my mind say?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.And what does my mind say?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.And what does my mind say?"

translation: A co niby myślę?

source_text: You think this is silly… I know your type.

structure.raw_value: ElFlDe.You think this is silly… I know your type.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlDe.You think this is silly… I know your type."

translation: Uważasz, że to głupie… Znam takich jak ty.

source_text: Come on, now. Don’t make assumptions.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Come on, now. Don’t make assumptions.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Come on, now. Don’t make assumptions."

translation: Daj spokój. Nie wyciągaj pochopnych wniosków.

source_text: I’m sure your looks bring in quite the salary.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I’m sure your looks bring in quite the salary.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I’m sure your looks bring in quite the salary."

translation: Założę się, że sporo zarabiasz na swoim wyglądzie.

source_text: I don’t starve. That’s for sure.

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.I don’t starve. That’s for sure.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.I don’t starve. That’s for sure."

translation: Na brak pieniędzy nie narzekam.

source_text: So, what exactly is it that you do?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.So, what exactly is it that you do?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.So, what exactly is it that you do?"

translation: Czym dokładnie się zajmujesz?

source_text: Maybe I can send you a sample.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.Maybe I can send you a sample.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.Maybe I can send you a sample."

translation: Może wyślę ci próbkę.

source_text: A photo?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.A photo?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.A photo?"

translation: Zdjęcie?

source_text: A dance video.

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.A dance video.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.A dance video."

translation: Nagranie z tańcem.

source_text: You’d have to give me your number. Are you cool with that?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You’d have to give me your number. Are you cool with that?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You’d have to give me your number. Are you cool with that?"

translation: Musiałabyś dać mi swój numer. Pasuje ci to?

source_text: Give me yours. I’ll send you a reward for a job well done.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.Give me yours. I’ll send you a reward for a job well done.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx.Give me yours. I’ll send you a reward for a job well done."

translation: Daj mi swój. Wyślę ci nagrodę za dobrze wykonaną robotę.

source_text: And what makes you think I give out my number?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.And what makes you think I give out my number?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.And what makes you think I give out my number?"

translation: A co cię skłania do myślenia, że rozdaje swój numer?

source_text: Playing hard to get?

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.Playing hard to get?
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.Playing hard to get?"

translation: Trudno cię zdobyć?

source_text: Since you’re famous, I can make an exception.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Since you’re famous, I can make an exception.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Since you’re famous, I can make an exception."

translation: Skoro jesteś sławna, mogę zrobić wyjątek.

source_text: Right…

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.Right…
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.Right…"

translation: Jasne…

source_text: Let me ask, 1Hero. Do you have a girlfriend?

structure.raw_value: ElFrOp.Let me ask, 1Hero. Do you have a girlfriend?
structure.script_literal: "ElFrOp.Let me ask, 1Hero. Do you have a girlfriend?"

translation: Powiedz mi, 1Hero. Masz dziewczynę?

source_text: I’m married to my work at the moment.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I’m married to my work at the moment.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I’m married to my work at the moment."

translation: Na razie jestem żonaty z pracą.

source_text: Are you asking me out?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Are you asking me out?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Are you asking me out?"

translation: Zapraszasz mnie na randkę?

source_text: I could use some private security.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.I could use some private security.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx.I could use some private security."

translation: Przydałaby mi się prywatna ochrona.

source_text: That’s all?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That’s all?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.That’s all?"

translation: Tylko tyle?

source_text: Are you hitting on me, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.Are you hitting on me, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.Are you hitting on me, 1Hero?"

translation: Podrywasz mnie, 1Hero?

source_text: And what type of security would you need?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.And what type of security would you need?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.And what type of security would you need?"

translation: Jakiej ochrony potrzebujesz?

source_text: Protection from stalkers.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.Protection from stalkers.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx.Protection from stalkers."

translation: Ochrony przed stalkerami.

source_text: Do you have stalkers?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you have stalkers?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you have stalkers?"

translation: Masz stalkerów?

source_text: Since I moved here, I’ve done better. But I still have trouble from time to time.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx.Since I moved here, I’ve done better. But I still have trouble from time to time.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx.Since I moved here, I’ve done better. But I still have trouble from time to time."

translation: Odkąd się tu przeprowadziłam, jest lepiej. Ale od czasu do czasu wciąż mam problemy.

source_text: Maybe you should disguise yourself.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Maybe you should disguise yourself.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Maybe you should disguise yourself."

translation: Może powinnaś się przebierać.

source_text: I want the attention. It’s good for business…

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.I want the attention. It’s good for business…
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.I want the attention. It’s good for business…"

translation: Chcę przyciągać uwagę. To dobre dla interesów…

source_text: What I need is someone I can contact if some stranger comes knocking at my door.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx.What I need is someone I can contact if some stranger comes knocking at my door.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx.What I need is someone I can contact if some stranger comes knocking at my door."

translation: Potrzebuję kogoś, do kogo zadzwonię, jeśli jakiś nieznajomy zapuka do moich drzwi.

source_text: Have you called the police?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Have you called the police?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Have you called the police?"

translation: Dzwoniłaś na policję?

source_text: Do you live nearby?

structure.raw_value: ElBaOp.Do you live nearby?
structure.script_literal: "ElBaOp.Do you live nearby?"

translation: Mieszkasz niedaleko?

source_text: I live close by, yes.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I live close by, yes.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I live close by, yes."

translation: Tak, mieszkam blisko.

source_text: I need someone who can show up at a moment’s notice.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx.I need someone who can show up at a moment’s notice.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx.I need someone who can show up at a moment’s notice."

translation: Potrzebuję kogoś, kto zjawi się na każde wezwanie.

source_text: And you live in the apartments next door?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.And you live in the apartments next door?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.And you live in the apartments next door?"

translation: A ty mieszkasz w sąsiednim bloku?

source_text: Care to help out a girl in need?

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.Care to help out a girl in need?
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.Care to help out a girl in need?"

translation: Pomożesz dziewczynie w potrzebie?

source_text: I’ll give you my number. But I’ll need to do a little research on you first.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’ll give you my number. But I’ll need to do a little research on you first.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I’ll give you my number. But I’ll need to do a little research on you first."

translation: Dam ci swój numer. Ale najpierw muszę trochę cię sprawdzić.

source_text: Okay, detective. Whatever you say.

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.Okay, detective. Whatever you say.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.Okay, detective. Whatever you say."

translation: Dobrze, detektywie. Jak sobie życzysz.

source_text: I better get home. I’ve got some videos to make.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.I better get home. I’ve got some videos to make.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx.I better get home. I’ve got some videos to make."

translation: Lepiej już pójdę do domu. Mam kilka filmików do nagrania.

source_text: Sounds fun.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Sounds fun.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Sounds fun."

translation: Brzmi fajnie.

source_text: I’ll send you some… research material.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.I’ll send you some… research material.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.I’ll send you some… research material."

translation: Wyślę ci trochę… materiałów do badań.

source_text: I look forward to checking it out.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I look forward to checking it out.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I look forward to checking it out."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać, żeby je obejrzeć.
